source: По темам армянских учебников математики для 10 класса (углубленный уровень)

stages.headline: Сколько вершин имеет пятиугольная призма?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many vertices does a pentagonal prism have?
stages.problemText: How many vertices does a pentagonal prism have?

stages.headline: Сколько ребер имеет четырехугольная пирамида?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many edges does a square pyramid have?
stages.problemText: How many edges does a square pyramid have?

stages.headline: Сколько граней имеет n-угольная призма?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many faces does an n-gonal prism have?
stages.problemText: How many faces does an n-gonal prism have?

stages.headline: Сколько ребер имеет n-угольная пирамида?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many edges does an n-gonal pyramid have?
stages.problemText: How many edges does an n-gonal pyramid have?

stages.headline: Многогранник имеет 6 вершин и 8 граней. Сколько у него ребер?
stages.headlineEnglish: A polyhedron has 6 vertices and 8 faces. How many edges?
stages.problemText: A polyhedron has 6 vertices and 8 faces. How many edges?
